cards.audioText: Did you have a good day yesterday? Did you have a good weekend?
cards.audioTextZh: 你昨天过得好吗？你周末过得好吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I had a good day yesterday. /Everything was as usual. Yes, I had a good weekend.
No, I had a terrible/bad day yesterday. I had a busy/tired/exhausting weekend.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我昨天过得很好。/一切如常。是的，我周末过得不错。

不好，我昨天过得很糟糕/不好。我周末很忙/累/疲惫。

cards.audioText: Do you like your leader to contact you after work hours? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢领导在下班后联系你吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Frankly speaking, I don't like to be contacted during my breaks. I want to enjoy the after-work time, but if there are important things, it depends.
cards.referenceTextZh: 坦白说，我不喜欢别人在休息时间联系我。我希望能享受休息的时间，但如果有重要的事情我会看情况而定。

cards.audioText: Tell me about a great change that occurred in your life.
cards.audioTextZh: 讲讲你生活中发生的大改变。
cards.referenceText: Honestly I haven't thought about this much, but the topic reminds me of my beginning of the flying career. I was selected from a key university to the Flight College, which changed my whole life and made my childhood dream come true.
cards.referenceTextZh: 说实话对此我没想过太多，但这个话题让我想起了飞行事业刚开始的阶段。我从一所重点大学被选拔到飞行学院，这改变了我整个人生，实现了我童年时的梦想。

cards.audioText: What is the importance of communication in daily life?
cards.audioTextZh: 交流在日常生活中的重要性是什么？
cards.referenceText: Communication is the mode of transferring information from one person to another. It is an essential skill for successful business and personal relationships. Effective communication is a must at work and in daily life.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交流是人与人之间传递信息的方式。交流是商务和人际关系中的重要技能。高效的交流在工作和生活中都是非常重要的。

cards.audioText: Have you experienced any awkward things in your life?
cards.audioTextZh: 你人生中遇到过尴尬的事么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, there are several funny stories in my life. The most awkward experience in my memory is that once I went into Lady's room and I didn't realize it until I came out.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过，我有许多有趣的经历。印象中最尴尬的是有一次去厕所，出来之后才意识到我错进了女厕所。

cards.audioText: What are your ambitions in life?
cards.referenceText: When I was young, my ambitions were to have a happy family and a desirable career, and both were fulfilled. Now, my ambitions in life are to make a good salary to support my family and keep physical and mental health every day.
cards.referenceTextZh: 年轻的时候，我希望能有一个幸福的家庭和一份理想的职业，这些都已经实现了。现在，我对生活的追求是用一份可观的收入养家，保持身体健康和好心情。
